_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. NOTE: this pipeline calls sec-form4-insider-tracker, whose own per-event charges also bill the buyer. The Form 4 child is EDGAR HTTP (no browser, no proxy) and the buyback 8-K stage is inline EDGAR, so compute per run is tiny and these prices stay well above it. Free tier kept to 1 conviction_buyback so any run with billable rows covers compute.

watch.eventDescription: One 8-K share repurchase announcement with no insider buying in the window. Includes the filing link, recency, and the insider buy/sell tally.

accumulation.eventDescription: A buyback announcement with insider open-market buying in the window. Includes the filing detail plus the insider buy/sell counts and dollar values.

conviction_buyback.eventDescription: A buyback announcement with a net insider buying cluster (two or more insiders) in the window and a conviction score of 55 or higher. The company and its insiders backing the stock at the same time. Includes full filing and insider buy detail. The first conviction buyback per run is free so you can validate output.
